title: PROLOGUE
content: Grove is AI-driven platform that helps users discover relevant and exciting projects tailored to their interest. This App concept connects one with another.

title: ACT I - Research
content: The Problem: The current project discovery platforms are not user-friendly and do not provide personalized recommendations. The Solution: Grove is an AI-driven platform that helps users discover relevant and exciting projects tailored to their interest.

title: ACT II - Process
content: The Design Process: The design process was divided into three phases: Research, Design, and Testing. The Research phase involved understanding the user needs and pain points. The Design phase involved creating wireframes and prototypes. The Testing phase involved testing the prototypes with users.

title: ACT III - Challenges
content: The Development Process: The development process involved building the front-end and back-end of the platform. The front-end was built using React.js and the back-end was built using Node.js. The platform was deployed on AWS.

title: EPILOGUE - Solution
content: The Outcome: Grove is an AI-driven platform that helps users discover relevant and exciting projects tailored to their interest. The platform has been well-received by users and has received positive feedback.

title: Reflections
content: The Future: The future of Grove is bright. The platform has the potential to become the go-to platform for project discovery. The team is excited to continue working on the platform and adding new features.
